name: claude-code-tooling-skills
description: Eight Claude Code skills for keeping a Claude Code setup safe and tidy: review third-party skills before install, lint and evaluate your own skill descriptions, audit the context budget, build least-privilege permissions, author and test hooks, and find skill collisions and portability problems.

plugins.name: claude-code-tooling
plugins.description: Eight skills, each with a tested standard-library script over local files: skill-supply-chain-review, skill-description-linter, skill-trigger-eval, context-budget-audit, permissions-builder, hook-author, skill-collision-check and skill-portability-check. They drive skill-scan-gate, cc-plugin-lock, claude-perm-sim, claude-mcp-allow and cc-hooks where those are installed. No network.
